description: This file contains the implementation of various matrix and tensor operations optimized for the XPU backend within the PyTorch framework. It includes functions like addmm, mm, baddbmm, bmm, addmv, tensordot, and their variants, along with related internal checks and kernel invocations.

methods.name: Tensor & addmm_out(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Computes result = beta * self + alpha * (mat1 * mat2) for XPU backend.

methods.name: Tensor & mm_out(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat2,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication of self and mat2, storing in result, optimized for XPU.

methods.name: Tensor & bmm_out(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & batch2,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs batch matrix multiplication for two 3D tensors.

methods.name: Tensor & addmv_out(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat,const Tensor & vec,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,Tensor & out)
methods.description: Performs the operation result = beta * self + alpha * (mat @ vec), with support for broadcasting.

methods.description: Computes tensor dot product with specified dims, ensuring dtype consistency.
